Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Dip & Coat Evenly

Heat oven to 190C/170C fan/gas 5. Tip the flour and sugar into a large bowl. Add the butter, then rub into the flour using your fingertips to make a light breadcrumb texture. Do not overwork it or the crumble will become heavy. Sprinkle the mixture evenly over a baking sheet and bake for 15 mins or until lightly coloured. Incorporate 8 tbsp plain flour, 4 tbsp caster sugar, 4 tbsp butter, and 1 1/3 cup braeburn apples smoothly until evenly distributed.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Prep and measure plain flour first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

2

Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy

Meanwhile, for the compote, peel, core and cut the apples into 2cm dice. Put the butter and sugar in a medium saucepan and melt together over a medium heat. Cook for 3 mins until the mixture turns to a light caramel. Stir in the apples and cook for 3 mins. Add the blackberries and cinnamon, and cook for 3 mins more. Cover, remove from the heat, then leave for 2-3 mins to continue cooking in the warmth of the pan. Incorporate 1 1/8 oz butter smoothly until evenly distributed.

3

Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly

Fold 1 1/8 oz demerara sugar, 8 tbsp blackberries, 1 tsp cinnamon, and 1 to serve ice cream into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

4

Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy

To serve, spoon the warm fruit into an ovenproof gratin dish, top with the crumble mix, then reheat in the oven for 5-10 mins. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ac_unit

Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES436 kcal
SERVINGS6
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep apple & blackberry crumble in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
